name: Ideogram Image
author: hearth-team
description: Image generation via Ideogram.ai — best-in-class typography handling. Use this when the image needs to render readable text (posters, ads, thumbnails, signage). Pass `model` to pick V_2 (default) or V_2_TURBO. Single prompt → image saved to /dashboard/collateral.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

vault_inputs.label: Ideogram API Key
vault_inputs.help: From ideogram.ai → Manage API. Stored encrypted.
